name.zh:
“没有恐惧是你不可战胜的。我们会助你直面它。”

她浅笑，仰望明月。
你感到月光沁入心中。
name.en:
" There is no fear you can't overcome. We will help you face it."

She smiles and looks up at the white moon above.
You feel the moonlight seep into your heart.
name.ja:
" There is no fear you can't overcome. We will help you face it."

She smiles and looks up at the white moon above.
You feel the moonlight seep into your heart.

Answer.ja: 見つけられない・・・

name.zh:
“没有野兽是你不可追踪的。我们会帮你找到它。”

你注意到野兽的踪迹，在月光下隐隐发亮。
野兽的方位已了然于心。
name.en:
" There is no beast you cannot track. We will help you find it."

You notice the beast's tracks, faintly glowing under the moonlight.
Your heart knows how to find it.
name.ja:
" There is no beast you cannot track. We will help you find it."

You notice the beast's tracks, faintly glowing under the moonlight.
Your heart knows how to find it.

Answer.ja: 私には・・・力が足りない

name.zh:
“没有野兽是你不可猎寻的。我们会同你消灭它。”

她的目光掠过你的淬毒猎矛。
武器上泛起月华。
name.en:
"There is no beast you cannot hunt. We will help you slay it."

Her eyes flick to your hunting spear, coated in poison.
The weapon glows with moonlight.
name.ja:
